theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (s : Finset ((Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ))) (w : (Fin (m + 1) → Fin P) × (Fin P → ℤ) → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (D : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), (∀ p ∈ s, StrictMono p.1) → (∀ p ∈ s, IntegrableOn (w p) {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), D ω = ∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, w p y * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (p.2 i : ℝ)) + ∑ j, y j • EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ)) (fun j => EuclideanSpace.single (p.1 j) (1 : ℝ))) → D.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∑ p ∈ s, ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, |w p y|)
